title: Machine Learning Best Practices

content.introduction: This document outlines the key principles and best practices for implementing machine learning solutions in enterprise environments.

sections.name: Data Preparation
sections.description: Data quality is fundamental to successful ML projects. Clean, well-structured data leads to better model performance.
best_practices: Split data properly for training and validation

sections.name: Model Selection
sections.description: Choosing the right algorithm depends on your problem type, data size, and performance requirements.

conclusion: Following these best practices will help ensure successful ML project outcomes and maintainable systems.
